requestedIntent: Preserve ACEF Full and Guarded risk controls while removing duplicate per-story assurance passes through a versioned four-actor lifecycle, deterministic story close, conditional adjudication, and bounded repair.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Full story lifecycle v3 removes duplicate assurance passes

limitations: Existing Full active runs without fullFlowContract remain six-actor-v2; v3 is not an in-place migration after lifecycle evidence exists.
The deterministic gate validates typed local artifacts, Git ancestry, hashes, and runner proof; it does not defeat a malicious actor able to forge the repository and every local record.
A Product Outcome Verifier remains conditional for user/runtime surfaces; the backend P0 candidate uses the frozen withheld behavioral oracle plus the mandatory Epic Process Judge.
The capability is enforced in this source tree but is not installed in target repositories until their ACEF tools, skills, schemas, and hooks are refreshed.

The frozen v3 P0 candidate manifest still awaits implementation-commit binding; after binding, the preregistered candidate must complete successfully before this capability can be called proven or authorized beyond a controlled canary.

evidence.note: Covers v3 defaulting, run-contract immutability, scopeUnit-derived gate routing, run-creation-frozen story inventory carried into actors and story/Epic gates, computed close verdicts, actor separation, authentic test-runner red evidence, and non-weakening red-to-green test binding.

Covers v2/v3 compatibility, real typed review-report binding, deterministic gate integrity, historical evidence ancestry, recomputed Patch Assurance final application/test-tree freshness, Epic Judge closeout, explicit v3 hook write authority, and terminal pre-commit behavior.

Covers four-actor topology parsing, conditional Judges, bounded Developer repair, exact-one regular-file close packages, aggregate conductor/child cost, terminal zero-write infrastructure retries, product-only harness-launched blind judgment, actor budgets, and separate harness-wait accounting.
Freezes the real-world P0 candidate and its quality, cost, topology, retry, and stop thresholds; the preregistration becomes active after implementation-commit binding.
